test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: How many times has India won the ICC T20 Men’s World Cup in cricket?
solution:
The correct answer is** 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **India **has won the** ICC Men's T20 World Cup**** in 2007 and 2024**.
 
• Led by **MS Dhoni**, the Indian cricket team emerged victorious** against Pakistan in the final,** securing a **five-run victory at the Wanderers Stadium in Johannesburg, South Africa**.
 
• **The 2007 ICC World Twenty20 **was the inaugural Twenty20 International cricket world championship, held in **South Africa from 11 to 24 September 2007.**
 
• India won the **2024 ICC Men's T20 World Cup by defeating South Africa **in the final, remaining unbeaten throughout the tournament.
 
• Jasprit Bumrah and Hardik Pandya were crucial to India's success, especially in the final​.
 
• **Virat Kohli and Rohit Sharma announced their retirement from T20I cricket.**
 
• **Matthew Hayden** was the leading run-scorer with 265 runs, while **Umar Gul** took the most wickets with 13.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **T20 cricket,** a condensed format comprising matches played over twenty overs per team, was introduced by the **England and Wales Cricket Board in 2003.**
 
• Over the course of the tournament's 13 editions, a total of 20 teams have vied for supremacy, with ten teams participating in the 2023 edition.
 
• Additionally, Pakistan and Sri Lanka had won once and England had won twice in this prestigious tournament.
